resources.string: T+/T− offsets now use a compact form such as 3h27m.
The same countdown format is used in the main view, daily paths, photos and panoramas.
CSV and TXT exports use the same hour-and-minute offsets.
Orbit points beneath the title bar remain visible but cannot be selected.
Orbit points beneath the information islands remain visible but cannot be selected.
Island navigation, details links and scrolling retain their usual behaviour.
